48d0a0471f8b8d9cc22e2a0c001b8b3c76bfd748.sourceText: 当前 `fake_vel_transform` 也配置为订阅 `odometry`、使用 `gimbal_yaw`，两者名称相符。`robot_base_frame` 决定里程计消息表达的机体系，不单独发布该机体系的 TF；已有机器人 TF 链连接 `base_footprint` 到 `gimbal_yaw`。云台独立 yaw 的角运动不能直接当作底盘角运动。
48d0a0471f8b8d9cc22e2a0c001b8b3c76bfd748.translatedText: Current `fake_vel_transform` is also configured as subscription `odometry` and uses `gimbal_yaw`; the two names match\.`robot_base_frame` determines the body frame expressed by the odometry message; it does not separately publish the TF for that body frame; the existing robot TF chain connects `base_footprint` to `gimbal_yaw`\. The angular motion of the gimbal's independent yaw cannot be directly treated as the chassis angular motion\.

48d884cb9a52b808e5cd0d9c0e374a2cacac0bb8.sourceText:
| 参数 | 你实际应该量什么 | 当前代码含义 |
|---|---|---|
| 底盘长度 | 车体刚性主体前沿到后沿，沿 X | `geometry_box x=...` |
| 底盘宽度 | 车体刚性主体左沿到右沿，沿 Y | `geometry_box y=...` |
| 底盘高度 | 刚性主体底面到顶面，沿 Z | `geometry_box z=...` |
| 轴距 | 前轮轴心到后轮轴心的 X 向距离 | `x_front - x_rear` |
| 轮距 | 左轮中心面到右轮中心面的 Y 向距离 | `y_left - y_right` |
| 轮径 | 轮子外圆直径 | 当前 `2 × 0.0758` |
| `chassis_height` | 地面 → `chassis` 坐标系原点 | 当前 0.076 m |
| `gimbal_yaw_height` | `chassis` 原点 → 云台 yaw 旋转轴原点 | 当前 0.1376 m |
| `gimbal_pitch_height` | yaw 轴原点 → pitch 轴原点 | 当前 0.16 m |
| Mid360 `pose` | parent 坐标系原点 → `front_mid360` 原点 | 当前相对 `chassis` |
48d884cb9a52b808e5cd0d9c0e374a2cacac0bb8.translatedText:
| Parameter | What you should actually measure | Meaning in the current code |
|---|---|---|
| Chassis length | The distance from the front edge to the rear edge of the rigid body of the vehicle body, along X | `geometry_box x=...` |
| Chassis width | The distance from the left edge to the right edge of the rigid body of the vehicle body, along Y | `geometry_box y=...` |
| Chassis height | The distance from the bottom face to the top face of the rigid body, along Z | `geometry_box z=...` |
| Wheelbase | The X\-direction distance from the front wheel axle center to the rear wheel axle center | `x_front - x_rear` |
| Track width | The Y\-direction distance from the center plane of the left wheel to the center plane of the right wheel | `y_left - y_right` |
| Wheel diameter | The outer diameter of the wheel | Current `2 × 0.0758` |
| `chassis_height` | Ground → `chassis` coordinate system origin | Current 0\.076 m |
| `gimbal_yaw_height` | `chassis` Origin → gimbal yaw rotation axis origin | Current 0\.1376 m |
| `gimbal_pitch_height` | yaw axis origin → pitch axis origin | Current 0\.16 m |
| Mid360 `pose` | parent coordinate system origin → `front_mid360` origin | Currently relative to `chassis` |

48ddd6f64f7fa2644edcf1485c6b14ac9e43d850.sourceText: 增大range_min可排掉更多近处回波，但也会漏掉车旁障碍；减小则可能带入车体、云台或其他自车点。0.3 m圆形门槛不是完整车辆轮廓，距底盘原点更远的自车回波仍可能留下，需要结合安装位置与真实车体观察。
48ddd6f64f7fa2644edcf1485c6b14ac9e43d850.translatedText: Increasing range_min can remove more near\-field echoes, but it may also miss obstacles beside the vehicle; decreasing it may bring in the vehicle body, gimbal, or other ego\-vehicle points\. The 0\.3 m circular threshold is not the complete vehicle outline; ego\-vehicle echoes farther from the chassis origin may still remain, so it must be combined with the installation position and actual vehicle body observations\.
